title: Lēctiō Adaptāta: Xenophōn
subtitle: Nārrātiō orīginālis, compositā ad imitandum stilum Xenophontis (clārum, simplex, chronologicum) — nōn excerptum authenticum, sed exercitium trānsitiōnāle ante Gradum VII.
objectives: Legere nārrātiōnem continuam prōsae adaptātae, imitantem stilum "cōnexum" Xenophonteum (Gradū VI priōre)
Applicāre grammaticam integram Gradūum I-VI ad textum longiōrem, sine adiūtōriō interlineārī cōnstantī
Recognōscere aliquot fōrmās novās (glōssātās) ut extēnsiōnem nātūrālem patrōnōrum iam nōtōrum (aoristus secundus, imperātīvus aoristī secundī), praeparāns lēctiōnem authenticam Gradūs VII
Distinguere nārrātīvē quid sit "lēctiō adaptāta" (compositiō didactica in stilō auctōris) ā "textū authenticō" (verba ipsa auctōris antīquī, Gradū VII)

content.intro: Nota bene: textus sequēns NŌN est excerptum verum ex operibus Xenophontis, sed nārrātiō ORĪGINĀLIS, hīc composita ad exercendum stilum eius (Anabasis-similem: mīlitēs, iter, dēcīsiōnēs practicae, prōsa clāra et directa) grammaticā omnīnō intrā id quod hic cursus iam docuit. Gradus VII tē dūcet ad verba ipsa auctōrum antīquōrum; haec lēctiō est pōns.
content.explanation: Lege prīmum sine versiōne Latīnā, adiuvante glōssāriō vocābulōrum novōrum īnfrā datō. Nōtā stilum "cōnexum" (Gradū VI priōre): clausulae relātīvē breves, iūnctae per δέ/καί, sine perīodīs longīs Thucydideīs.

rules.heading: Textus: Ἡ Διάβασις (Trānsitus)
rules.body:
Οἱ Ἕλληνες ἐπορεύοντο διὰ τῆς χώρας. Ποταμὸς μέγας ἦν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ. Οἱ στρατιῶται ἐφοβοῦντο· οὐ γὰρ ᾔδεσαν πῶς περάσουσιν. Ὁ δὲ στρατηγὸς ἐκέλευσεν αὐτοὺς μὴ φοβεῖσθαι. “Ἐὰν φοβώμεθα,” ἔφη, “οὐδέποτε περάσομεν.” Τέλος δὲ εὗρον χωρίον τι, καὶ ἐκεῖ τὸ ὕδωρ βραχύτερον ἦν. Ἀσφαλῶς οὖν περὶ τὴν ἑσπέραν ἐπέρασαν.

Versiō Latīna:

Graecī per regiōnem iter faciēbant. Flūmen magnum erat in viā. Mīlitēs timēbant; nōn enim sciēbant quōmodo trānsīrent. Dux autem eōs iussit nōlle timēre. “Sī timēbimus,” inquit, “numquam trānsībimus.” Tandem invēnērunt locum quendam, et ibi aqua brevior erat. Tūtō igitur circā vesperam trānsiērunt.

Glōssārium (vocābula nova vel nōtātū digna): πορεύομαι ("eō, iter faciō", dēpōnēns, imperfectum ex patrōnō λύομαι) · ᾔδεσαν ("sciēbant", ā verbō οἶδα, fōrma memoranda) · περάω ("trānseō", verbum contractum in -άω) · ἔφη ("dīxit", ā verbō φημί, fōrma frequentissima memoranda) · εὗρον ("invēnī/invēnērunt", aoristus secundus verbī εὑρίσκω, patrōnus iam nōtus) · βραχύτερον (comparātīvus, "brevior") · ἑσπέρα ("vesper").

examples: ἐφοβοῦντο, οὐ γὰρ ᾔδεσαν πῶς περάσουσιν. — Timēbant, nōn enim sciēbant quōmodo trānsīrent. (γάρ postpositīvum, Gradū VI)
ἐὰν φοβώμεθα, οὐδέποτε περάσομεν. — Sī timēbimus, numquam trānsībimus. (condiciō futūra vīvida, Gradū V)
ἐκέλευσεν αὐτοὺς μὴ φοβεῖσθαι. — Iussit eōs nōlle timēre. (μή + īnfīnītīvus, Gradū IV)
τέλος δὲ εὗρον χωρίον τι. — Tandem invēnērunt locum quendam. (aoristus secundus, Gradū IV)
ἀσφαλῶς περὶ τὴν ἑσπέραν ἐπέρασαν. — Tūtō circā vesperam trānsiērunt.

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere hunc textum esse citātiōnem verbōtenus ex Anabasī Xenophontis.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere explicitē: est compositiō didactica ORĪGINĀLIS, imitāns stilum, nōn excerptum authenticum.
commonMistakes.why: Honestās academica requīrit distinctiōnem clāram inter "adaptātum in stilō" et "verba ipsa auctōris" — cōnfūsiō hīc esset error scholāris.

commonMistakes.wrong: Trānsferre verbum-prō-verbō, prōdūcendō Latīnum īnfrāctum, potius quam reconstruere sēnsum tōtīus sententiae.
commonMistakes.right: Legere tōtam sententiam prīmum (usāns glōssārium prō vocābulīs novīs), deinde reconstruere sēnsum nātūrālem.
commonMistakes.why: Habitus "lēctiōnis reālis" (nōn sōlum trānslātiōnis mechanicae) est obiectīvum praecipuum huius gradūs et Gradūs VII sequentis.

commonMistakes.wrong: Frūstrārī cum fōrmīs novīs (ἔφη, εὗρον) sine cōnsulere glōssārium, crēdendō errōrem esse.
commonMistakes.right: Adhibēre glōssārium prō fōrmīs novīs vel irregulāribus — pars normālis lēctiōnis cuiuslibet linguae, etiam prō locūtōribus nātīvīs antīquīs discentibus scrībere.
commonMistakes.why: Vocābulum novum, praesertim verbum irregulāre commūne (φημί, εὑρίσκω), est expectandum in tōtā lēctiōne futūrā.

exercises.title: Intellēctūs Textūs
exercises.instructions: Secundum nārrātiōnem, dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Mīlitēs timēbant quia nōn sciēbant quōmodo flūmen trānsīrent.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: "ἐφοβοῦντο, οὐ γὰρ ᾔδεσαν πῶς περάσουσιν."
Falsum: iussit eōs nōlle timēre, nōn fugere.

items.statement: Invēnērunt locum ubi aqua erat profundior (altior).
items.explanation: Falsum: aqua erat βραχύτερον, "brevior/humilior", nōn altior.

items.prompt: Quid significat ἔφη in hōc textū?
items.explanation: Ἔφη est aoristus (fōrma irregulāris) verbī φημί, "dīxit".

items.prompt: Ad quam classem grammaticam pertinet εὗρον?
items.explanation: Εὗρον sequitur patrōnum aoristī secundī (Gradū IV), thema mūtātum, sine σ.

items.prompt: Quod genus condiciōnis exemplificat "ἐὰν φοβώμεθα, οὐδέποτε περάσομεν"?
items.explanation: Ἐάν + coniūnctīvus, futūrum indicātīvum: genus 3 (Gradū V).

items.prompt: Quī stilus (Gradū VI) exemplificātur ab hōc textū?
items.explanation: Clausulae breves, iūnctae per δέ/καί — stilus cōnexus.

exercises.title: Complē secundum Textum
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā secundum textum.

options: compositiō didactica orīginālis, imitāns stilum Xenophontis
items.explanation: Nōn citātiō vēra, sed pōns pedagogicus.

items.prompt: Strategia lēctiōnis hōc textū recommendāta est:
options: legere tōtam sententiam prīmum, deinde reconstruere sēnsum

items.statement: Textus hic est citātiō verbōtenus ex Anabasī Xenophontis.
Mīlitēs invēnērunt locum ubi aqua erat brevior.
Stilus textūs est cōnexus, cum clausulīs iūnctīs per δέ/καί.
Ἐὰν φοβώμεθα, οὐδέποτε περάσομεν exemplificat condiciōnem futūram vīvidam.

summary: Textus est compositiō didactica ORĪGINĀLIS in stilō Xenophonteō — nōn excerptum verum, explicitē notandum.
Grammatica applicāta est integrē intrā id quod Gradūs I-VI docuērunt: dēclīnātiōnēs, coniugātiōnēs, condiciōnēs, particulae.
Fōrmae novae (ἔφη, εὗρον) sunt glōssātae ut vocābulum irregulāre commūne, extēnsiō nātūrālis patrōnōrum iam nōtōrum.
Stilus "cōnexus" (clausulae breves, δέ/καί) contrāstat cum stilō periodicō (Gradū VI, lēctiō priōre) — hoc textum exemplificat illum.
